function.name: lookup_patient
function.description: Check whether a patient record already exists for a phone number. Call with no arguments at the start of the call to use caller ID, or pass phone_number if the caller gives a different number.

phone_number.description: 10-digit U.S. phone number to look up (optional; defaults to caller ID)

headers.x-vapi-secret: <VAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, set in the Vapi dashboard, never committed>

messages.content: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with our system right now.
